reference: Ka-50 (single seat). Panel placed from photos cockpit-refs/ka50/ka50_01.jpg (Ka-50 Black Shark cockpit, Alex Beltyukov, CC BY-SA 3.0: IT-23 with the ABRIS to its right, flight dials left) and the front-panel pages of Chuck's DCS Ka-50 guide (layout reference only: p-028 whole front panel, p-030/p-031 left flight block, p-034 caution-lights panel and master caution, p-044 EKRAN, SAI, ABRIS and engine dials). ka50_02..04.jpg are Ka-52 (different glass panel), not used. Left wing: column B (G-meter, airspeed, altimeter, blade angle) and outer column A (lamp-test switches, radar altimeter, rotor RPM, clock); centre: caution-lights panel over column C (VVI, ADI, HSI), the IT-23 under the ILS-31 HUD (0.31 m, kept), the PUI-800 below it (rounds counter, switches); right wing: EKRAN and the standby ADI over the ABRIS, with EGT, engine RPM and fuel below it (on the real panel they are a column right of the ABRIS: the 0.22 m wing has no room for both). The texture has no turquoise: the panel is its nearest blue.
